title: edit-parse-rule command payload

profileId.description: ParseProfiles.Id; the admin generates it (v7) for a new rule.

departmentId.description: The department scope (ParseProfiles.DepartmentId): the rule applies to the sources of that department's collections only; absent = every department.

domain.description: A lower-case host (A-label), or *. and a host for its subdomains only.

pathGlob.description: Glob over the whole unescaped URL path, case-insensitive: * any run of characters (/ included), ? one character, e.g. /kommun/protokoll/*.

mediaType.description: A media type or type/*, as detected (Documents.MediaType).

textPattern.description: .NET regular expression (linear-time subset: no lookarounds or backreferences) matched on the title or the first 2,000 characters of the parsed text, case-insensitive.

maxLevel.description: Headings deeper than this become bold body text; absent = 4.

paragraphItemsAreSections.description: Each § N item is a level-1 section (as the built-in protokoll rule).

furniture.description: .NET regular expressions (linear-time subset) of lines that clean drops as furniture, e.g. signature blocks.

cleanupRules.description: Structure hints for clean and split by headings; absent = the defaults.

decidedBy.description: The deciding platform admin's oid, written to the audit entry; absent = system:worker.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command edit-parse-rule (processing design §3.5): creates or changes the manual parse rule profileId (content.ParseProfiles, Origin manual, State active) at the job's level; a change is a new revision, audited, and re-processes the sources with parser-route documents in the old or the new scope. The lengths keep the payload within 4 KB. Dedup parse-rule:{profileId}.
